description: This file contains the implementation of an LDAP driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It provides classes and methods to connect, query, and manage LDAP databases, including connection management, configuration options, and search result processing.

classes.name: ADODB_ldap
classes.description: Manages LDAP connections, including connecting, configuring options, and retrieving server info.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ldap
classes.description: Handles LDAP search results, providing methods to fetch records as associative arrays, numeric arrays, or both.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to an LDAP server with given host, credentials, and base.

methods.name: _inject_bind_options
methods.description: Sets specified LDAP options on the current connection.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Performs an LDAP search query with the specified filter.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message related to LDAP operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last LDAP error number.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Sets the LDAP base DN for subsequent operations.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves configuration and server info, such as protocol version and referral handling.
